Only the build-maxperf, build-tools-maxperf, install-maxperf and install-tools-maxperf recipes set RUSTFLAGS="-C target-cpu=native" with --features jemalloc,asm-keccak, which is the only documented path to keccak1600-avx512vl. The upstream op-reth bin (rust/op-reth/bin/Cargo.toml) has asm-keccak in its defaults, but X Layer does not build that binary.

cleared.check: Which keccak routine the official X Layer image runs for KECCAK256, pool ids (src/types/PoolId.sol:14) and position keys (src/libraries/Position.sol:60).
cleared.result: Corrected after verification. The image sets no RUSTFLAGS and bin/node has no default features, but bin/node depends on the workspace crate reth, taken from okx/reth f60420a without default-features = false (xlayer-reth Cargo.toml:88). That crate's default features include asm-keccak and keccak-cache-global (okx/reth bin/reth/Cargo.toml:85-94 and :113-117), and Cargo unifies features across the build, so the official image compiles alloy-primitives with keccak-asm. With RUSTFLAGS empty the routine assembled is the generic x86-64 one, which is what cycle 32 recorded and what the endpoint tests of cycles 28 to 34 exercised: the 120 KECCAK256 offset and length pairs of the battery and every pool id and mapping slot in the script sets match on the public endpoint. The AVX-512 routine needs a build with CPU-specific flags. The routine of the official image has not been lifted from the image itself (new lead).
